answer: Time-locked bonds require each identity to lock a 30-day vesting stake decaying on early withdrawal. A sybil attacker must lock 30 days of capital per clone, so 1,000 clones park 1,000 bonds before earning, as immature bonds cannot mine or grade. The protocol applies this via vesting schedules with forfeiture on early exit. The garden registry locks enrollment, the tide attestation log records proofs, and the lantern checkpoint settles penalties.
